## Starting from a phylo object

```{r}
library(ContPhylo)
library(ape)
set.seed(0)
p=rtree(10)
plot(p)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```

```{r}
r=phylo2contphylo(p)
plot(r)
```

```{r}
p=contphylo2phylo(r)
plot(p)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```

## Starting from a contphylo object

```{r}
set.seed(0)
r=rcontphylo(10)
plot(r)
```

```{r}
p=contphylo2phylo(r)
plot(p)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```

```{r}
r=phylo2contphylo(p)
plot(r)
```
